profile_text.body:
Amazon is a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States.

The company's website provided no substantive description of its current operations or AI products for this profile.

According to held facts, Amazon has four Model Context Protocol servers registered: ai.sellermate/amazon-ads for Amazon Ads account management with OAuth and guardrails, ai.trendsapi/amazon for Amazon product search volume and best-seller trends, ai.trendsmcp/amazon for Amazon product search demand tracking, and app.apiguru/amazon-data for live Amazon product, review, search, deal, offer and stock data across 20 marketplaces. Amazon faces litigation exposure in Washington state, with 96 cases tracked there.
